fields.description: The durable fact, preference, or decision — one per row. Written by the `remember` skill or by the team in Desk.
fields.label: Memory

fields.description: Whose memory this is. Recall is strictly profile-scoped — an agent never sees another profile's memories.
fields.label: Agent Profile

fields.description: Project this memory belongs to (Design 73). Set when the memory is learned in a project room. Recall in a project room returns THIS project's memories + untagged/global ones — never another project's. Blank = global.
fields.label: Project

fields.description: Optional grouping tag — a client, a brief ID (e.g. 'BB-0001'), a topic. For filtering in Desk.
fields.label: Subject

fields.description: Hermes USER.md/MEMORY.md split (design 80): 'user_profile' = a fact about the USER (role, preferences, working style, pet peeves); 'general' = the agent's own notes (decisions, conventions, learnings). Recall labels them so the model treats user facts as 'about you'.
fields.label: Memory Type

fields.description: Active memories are injected into every turn (newest first, token-capped). Archive instead of deleting — the audit trail stays.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The session in which this memory was learned (audit trail).
fields.label: Source Session
